scope: Source-only independent delta review and small saved metadata reads; no imports of benchmark code, tests, builds, model calls, plan execution, binary/model/archive hashing or benchmark reruns. Parent owns plan validation and execution.
exact_delta_exhaustively_accounted_for: fixed job mode sequential/expanded -> joint/compact; unpacked retained
distinct compact plan kind in preparation and validation
preserved_checks: two warmups from the frozen workload and three measured repetitions
control-before, candidate, control-after using control binary twice
caller-supplied exact plan SHA checked before plan parsing/input work
bound workload/build/binary/archive/source inventory at validation and after the measured bracket
900-second per-process timeout and scoped child kill/reap on timeout/interruption/start-receipt failure
historical literal text/token/count/stop/dimension signatures and free-running FP32 repetition checks
five-percent control drift and latency-target thresholds; default_promotion remains false
single_page_limit: The joint API receives one image and follows Runner.recognize_batch_with_trace singleton -> recognize_with_trace; runner and benchmark example source hashes match the saved control build. This is no evidence of multirow joint-decode performance.
